Entries.Original: So, Aoi. We're doing it, right?
We literally just got here. Explain it to her more clearly.
I'm talking about the concert. Let's gather some people and DO IT.
What?! I can't perform in front of people! My skills aren't up to par!
If you avoid concerts until you perfect your skills, you're not going to be on stage until you're old and wrinkly. That's how bands work. Ruka assured.
You don't need to keep assuring it. I'm sure people will quote you in the future if what you just said is that important.
A concert means we'll be performing right in front of an audience, right?
Yep. If we bring our instruments to the cafeteria and start jamming, people will start gathering naturally.
That sounds like a scene right out of an anime...
Well, this is real life! Here, let's start moving our equipment out and get ready to jam.
